name: Cisco Ready: Part Serial Number Search
description: Search for and retrieve part/device serial number details from Cisco Ready. Enter a serial number to look up device information, configuration, warranty status, and support history. Provides complete hardware asset details for a specific part.

steps.description: Navigate to Cisco Ready SN Search page
Wait for radio button to become visible, Search based on SAV ID
Enter SAV ID into search field
steps.param_description: SAV ID to request IB in Cisco Ready

steps.description: Wait for page to process SAV ID and results to be ready
Select first SAV customer using keyboard

outputs.name: request_submission
outputs.label: Request Submission
outputs.js: (function() { var text = (document.body && (document.body.innerText || document.body.textContent) || '').replace(/\r/g, ''); var requestMatch = text.match(/Your request for[\s\S]*?submitted successfully\./i); var followupMatch = text.match(/You will get the report shortly\.[\s\S]*?Thank you\./i); var requestIdMatch = text.match(/Request ID\s*([0-9]+)/i); var lines = []; if (requestMatch) lines.push(requestMatch[0].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()); if (followupMatch) lines.push(followupMatch[0].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()); var clickLine = /Click here to request another report/i.test(text) ? 'Click here to request another report' : ''; if (clickLine) lines.push(clickLine); return { request_id: requestIdMatch ? requestIdMatch[1] : '', confirmation_text: lines.join('\n') || text.slice(0, 4000) }; })()
outputs.parse_instructions:
Use confirmation_text and request_id to produce a final user-facing markdown summary. Format EXACTLY like this:
## Cisco Ready Request Submitted
**Status:** Submitted Successfully
**Request ID:** <id or N/A>
**Message:** <one-line confirmation summary>
**Next Step:** You will receive the report shortly by email.
Do not use semicolons or equals signs.

fields.description: Request ID extracted from the success confirmation

fields.description: Submission status, expected value: Submitted Successfully
